info.name: Chronos API — Complete
info.description:
Chronos API — Complete collection (all endpoints).

Main API:  http://chronos.us-east-1.elasticbeanstalk.com
BlockHub:  http://blockhub-env.us-east-1.elasticbeanstalk.com

HOW TO USE
1. Open the Health folder and hit both health checks to confirm both services are up.
2. Run Auth > Register (or Login) — token is auto-saved to {{token}}.
3. All protected requests use {{token}} automatically.
4. BlockHub shares the same token — no separate login.
5. IDs returned by requests (accountId, walletId, nftId, etc.) are auto-saved as collection variables.

FOLDERS
  Health       — liveness checks (Main API + BlockHub)
  Auth         — register, login, forgot/reset password
  Banking      — accounts, wallets, cards, transfers, transactions, deposits, bills, FX, KYC
  TickPay/BNPL — buy-now-pay-later accounts, purchases, repayments
  LifeX        — 11 personal development modules
  Panther AI   — Kevin chat, alerts, voice, scoring
  Notifications — in-app notification management
  BlockHub     — crypto trading + NFT minting/marketplace
